name: Nanase Ako
source:
A member of the theater troupe. 

She always smiles, has a gentle personality, and treats everyone kindly, but is strong-willed, and when she reaches a decision, she will stubbornly see it through to the end. 

She has a habit of disappearing before rehearsals and performances, but none of the troupe members know where she goes. She is a woman of much mystery.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=71]MangaGamer[/url]]

Voiced by Iino Shiori.
